subject.title: fix(deps): keep Hermit on patched web packages

question: Should Hermit retain a repository-wide PostCSS override at 8.5.23, or should the update be limited to the direct dependency after reviewing the resolved transitive graph?
rationale: The override is an intentional dependency-policy choice that affects every transitive PostCSS consumer; the supplied patch does not show why the broader pin is required.

options.title: Keep the override
options.body: Retain the root override after confirming it is required for the advisory and that the resolved graph and CSS build work.

options.title: Limit the update
options.body: Update the direct PostCSS dependency and lockfile only if transitive consumers do not require a global override.

recommendation.title: Keep the override
recommendation.body: Retain the root override after confirming it is required for the advisory and that the resolved graph and CSS build work.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies this repository member as the author of the dependency policy change; no stronger package-history owner could be established from the read-only environment.
